name: drive-bench-data
description: A dataset for benchmarking autonomous driving and driving-assistant systems that contains recorded driving data (sensor logs, images/videos and annotations) intended to support perception and short-horizon behavior/trajectory tasks. It is intended for evaluating detection, segmentation, and short-term motion/behavior prediction under realistic driving conditions. Different tasks in the collection use task-specific labels and annotations for quantitative comparison of algorithms.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (e.g., mAP for detection, mIoU for segmentation, ADE/FDE for trajectory prediction)
reputation: An emerging dataset for autonomous-driving research with moderate visibility in the community.
